audit.why: Before Nimbus Strike is a reliable escape the anchor pull is free; from 4 the dash plus Warrior Trickster bait single-target CC and Cyclone beats the engage outright.
audit.corrected: Level 2 Nautilus, Level 3 Skill, Levels 4-5 and 6 Wukong.

audit.why: Spikes read levels 2-3, level 6 Cyclone, his first item armour-shred spike and late clone abuse — all four present and ordered correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Crushing Blow's auto-attack reset is never mentioned, and the whole content layer is written in first person ('I', 'my') instead of the user's second-person voice.
audit.why: The reset means the burst tell is the wind-up, not the ability cast; players who watch for a cast animation eat the trade. The voice break is visible on every line of this matchup's content layer.
audit.corrected: Add the reset tell and convert the prose to second person.

edits.before: Neither of us has an all-in at level 1, but my passive root on the first auto makes a quick walk-up trade favorable if he steps up to farm.
edits.after: Neither side has an all-in at level 1, but your passive root on the first auto makes a quick walk-up trade favourable if he steps up to farm.

edits.before: With Q anchor, W shield-burn, and E slow online I can land a guaranteed pull-into-root short trade before his E dash is a reliable escape.
edits.after: With Dredge Line, W shield-burn and Riptide online you land a guaranteed pull-into-root short trade before Nimbus Strike is a reliable escape.

edits.before: He hits his power tools too — his E dash and Q armor-shred let him reset autos and trade back, neutralizing my pull window.
edits.after: He gets his tools too — Nimbus Strike and Crushing Blow's auto reset let him trade back, neutralising your pull window.

edits.before: His Cyclone knockup out-all-ins my engage — he clone-baits my Depth Charge, dashes on the real me, and spins me up.
edits.after: Cyclone out-all-ins your engage — he clone-baits Depth Charge, dashes onto the real you, and spins you up.

edits.before: His clone makes my Q pull and R lock the wrong unit and he out-scales my tank-only build — I'm a utility bot he kites and bursts.
edits.after: His clone makes your Q pull and R lock the wrong unit and he out-scales your tank-only build — you become a utility bot he bursts.

edits.before: Level 1 is roughly even — neither of us has an all-in, but my passive root on the first auto makes a quick walk-up favorable if he steps to last-hit. My real moment is levels 2-3: once Q (the anchor pull) plus W (shield and splash-burn autos) plus E (the slow) are online, I can land Q into passive-root and stack W-charged autos before his E dash is a reliable escape. Do NOT throw Q at his clone or into the dash — if I miss the anchor I have no follow-up and he resets autos on me with his Q armor-shred. Force the short trade only when his E is on cooldown.
edits.after: Level 1 is roughly even — neither side has an all-in, but your passive root on the first auto makes a quick walk-up favourable if he steps to last-hit. Your real moment is levels 2-3: once Dredge Line, W's shield and splash-burn autos, and Riptide's slow are online, you land Q into passive-root and stack W-charged autos before Nimbus Strike is a reliable escape. Do NOT throw Q at his clone or into the dash — miss the anchor and you have no follow-up while Crushing Blow resets an auto into your armour. Force the short trade only when his E is down.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Crushing Blow is an auto reset — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.
